name: read-relay
description: Keeps bulk file reading out of the main context by relaying large reads to a cheap read-only subagent.

threshold_lines.title: Line threshold
threshold_lines.description: Reads that would pull in more than this many lines are relayed to the bulk-reader subagent. Spotify's shunt uses 350; the right value depends on your codebase, so measure before tuning. Also settable as READ_RELAY_THRESHOLD_LINES.

max_bounces.title: Bounces per file
max_bounces.description: How many times one file may be refused in a session before it is let through. 1 nudges once and never blocks a deliberate retry. 0 disables the guard. Higher values push harder but always leave a way out. Also settable as READ_RELAY_MAX_BOUNCES.

guard_bash.title: Also guard bash reads
guard_bash.description: Block plain cat / less / more / bat on large files, even inside a && / ; chain. Piped, redirected and already-bounded commands are always allowed. Also settable as READ_RELAY_GUARD_BASH.

skip_patterns.title: Always-allow patterns
skip_patterns.description: Comma-separated globs that are never relayed, matched against the full path and the basename. Also settable as READ_RELAY_SKIP_PATTERNS.
